title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 09:00 UTC on 22 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 22 日 09:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.00 (0Z) at 09:00 UTC. The 09:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 09:59; hour-end 0.00/0Z). The trailing 10:00 hour is incomplete (13 samples through 10:12) and is not used as the headline hour. Last-180 maximum is 0.33 (first at 2026-09-22 07:21 UTC; label 0P; last-180 window from 07:13 UTC). Published-window maximum is 1.00 (05:44 UTC; label 1Z). Window start 2026-09-22 04:15 UTC (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最後可靠整點估計 Kp 為 0.00（0Z），取樣 09:00 UTC。09:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 09:59，時段末 0.00／0Z）。10:00 時段尚未收滿（13 筆至 10:12），不作為主卡片整點。近 180 筆最大 0.33（最先見於 2026-09-22 07:21 UTC；標籤 0P；近 180 筆窗自 07:13 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 1.00（05:44 UTC；標籤 1Z）。窗起點 2026-09-22 04:15 UTC（358 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (09:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 09:00 UTC is 0.00/0Z; the hour stays quiet (ends 0.00/0Z at 09:59). The incomplete 10:00 hour is excluded from the headline.

title.en: A magnitude 4.6 earthquake occurred 19 km ENE of Nailong, Philippines on 22 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 22 日，菲律賓 Nailong 東北東約 19 公里發生規模 4.6 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 4.6, depth about 10 km. Current day-feed maximum is mb 5.3 (us7000tj1s, 97 km S of Sarangani, Philippines).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 4.6，深度約 10 公里。一日饋送目前最大為 mb 5.3（us7000tj1s，菲律賓 Sarangani 以南約 97 公里）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
